summary: The global marketing team is executing a China-first promotion strategy, with Asia Start and Intelligent China as top priorities, while finalizing the Knowledge website redesign and managing a critical email lockout that has stalled immediate work.
summaryDetail: The most urgent issue is the Outlook account lockout affecting the whole team, requiring everyone to delete and re-login with the new password across all devices and contact IT to confirm the unlock—this must be resolved today to avoid further delays. In parallel, the team is advancing the China-first strategy from the June 30 sync, prioritizing Asia Start and the new Intelligent China program over US partnerships; Joseph is drafting a targeting plan, the team is building participant and CRM profiles, and conversion tracking documentation and audit are pending. The Knowledge website redesign is nearing completion: the team has chosen the current design with menu categorization improvements, will disperse videos by topic, and will integrate BCI/BSI indices; Joseph, Julie, and the team lead need to hold a 30-minute feedback session, and Joker will then make design changes. Upcoming items include the 2026 Women in Leadership Forum design feedback, a motion banner for CKGSB Monthly, a cost estimate for a separate Americas website, and follow-ups on the Asia Start video and Flow invoice. Additionally, TIAN Xuefang and LIU Xuan have October 16 action items that appear to be future-dated and may need review for relevance.

decisions.text: Use the new password across all devices and remove unused accounts to prevent lockouts.
Remove the standalone videos section; videos will be dispersed by topic across the site.
Keep the two-menu structure (Knowledge menu and School menu) at the top.
Bring BCI and BSI indices into the Knowledge section, similar to the school homepage banner.
Do not add a stock-market ticker at the very top of the homepage.
Display more articles on the homepage using a pinned article plus latest/more articles layout.
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China as top two programs to promote; US partnerships on hold for now.
Berkeley program to be considered as a possible third priority and included in the audit phase.
Proceed with deploying the updated program promotion preview links on the live site
